say:4:1410341001:0.text: Zanie... someone told me they spotted a sneaky figure around here, someone who looked just like you.

say:5:1410341002:0.text: I thought it was just some drunken rambling, but I never expected it to really be you.
say:5:1410341002:0.source_cn: 我还以为他是喝多了说胡话，没想到，真的是你。

say:6:1410341003:1.text: It's been a hundred years since you've been home, and now you think you can just waltz off without a word?
say:6:1410341003:1.source_cn: 一百年没回家，你连个招呼也不打就想离开？恐怕没那么容易。

say:9:1410341004:1.text: Given how our relationship is, let's skip the pleasantries.
say:9:1410341004:1.source_cn: 就凭我们这比纸还薄的关系，打招呼什么的还是免了吧。

say:12:1410341005:0.text: I don't care where you're headed or what you're up to, but you're not sneaking off with our envoy. He's an honored guest of Brimstone Village.
say:12:1410341005:0.source_cn: 我管不着你想去哪里，想做什么。但你可不能偷偷拐走我们尊...
say:12:1410341005:0.male: I don't care where you're headed or what you're up to, but you're not sneaking off with our envoy. He's an honored guest of Brimstone Village.
say:12:1410341005:0.female: I don't care where you're headed or what you're up to, but you're not sneaking off with our envoy. She's an honored guest of Brimstone Village.

say:15:1410341006:1.text: Sneaking off? You're spouting nonsense again!

say:18:1410341007:0.text: Magister, that dwarf is not like us. She's up to no good. You'd do well to stay clear of her.
say:18:1410341007:0.source_cn: 特使大人，那位矮人与我们不同，并非善类，您赶紧离她远一些。
say:18:1410341007:0.male: Magister, that dwarf is not like us. She's up to no good. You'd do well to stay clear of her.
say:18:1410341007:0.female: Magister, that dwarf is not like us. She's up to no good. You'd do well to stay clear of her.

say:19:1410341008:0.text: We'll handle Zanie, don't worry about whatever she was trying to swindle you into. You're free to go.
say:19:1410341008:0.source_cn: 祖娅我们会严肃处理，至于您……还是，早点离开锻炉峡湾为好。

say:22:1410341010:0.text: You've broken our village's rules. Even if you are an envoy, I'm not letting you off the hook that easily!
say:22:1410341010:0.source_cn: 公然违背深岩村的规矩，就算是特使大人，我也不能轻易放你走！
say:22:1410341010:0.male: You've broken our village's rules. Even if you are an envoy, I'm not letting you off the hook that easily!

say:25:1410341011:1.text: Ha, do you really think your flimsy rules can stop an imperial envoy?
say:25:1410341011:1.source_cn: 哼，就凭你编的那几条规矩，还想拖住耀光特使？
say:25:1410341011:1.male: Ha, do you really think your flimsy rules can stop an imperial envoy?
say:25:1410341011:1.female: Ha, do you really think your flimsy rules can stop an imperial envoy?

say:26:1410341015:1.text: Eldric, stop twisting the truth! I know what you're up to!
say:26:1410341015:1.source_cn: 弗林，你少在那颠倒黑白！我知道你打着什么算盘！

say:27:1410341016:1.text: Rebuilding the temple, resurrecting Helthor... Your actions aren't out of faith in Helthor! You just want Helthor to give you the power to wield magic yourself!
say:27:1410341016:1.source_cn: 重铸神殿，复活赫托……你的所作所为，并不是出于对赫托的...

say:30:1410341017:0.text: Exactly! I need magic! I need to wield it with my own hands! Without it, we'll never forge perfect weapons. We'll always rely on mages, on the Essail... never reaching the true peak of craftsmanship!
say:30:1410341017:0.source_cn: 没错！我需要魔法！我需要亲手使用魔法！否则我们永远无法...

say:33:1410341018:1.text: What you're doing is madness! You even dared to harm an imperial envoy! It's outright treason!
say:33:1410341018:1.source_cn: 你的做法太疯狂了！你甚至敢伤害帝国的特使！一旦帝国追究...

say:38:1410341020:0.text: Ridiculous. We're not after regime change. The Empire and all other factions will all rot away with time.
say:38:1410341020:0.source_cn: 笑话，我们要的从来就不是什么政权的更迭。帝国也好，耀光...
say:38:1410341020:0.male: Ridiculous. We're not after regime change. The Empire and all other factions will all rot away with time.

say:42:1410341023:0.text: Look at these weapons forged from echorites, Zanie. They're already perfect... but still not enough.
say:42:1410341023:0.source_cn: 看看深岩晶制造出的武器，祖娅。它们已经很完美了，但还不够。

say:43:1410341024:0.text: If we could use magic, we could create artifacts beyond all limits. We could revive ancient techniques lost to time! That's worth fighting for!
say:43:1410341024:0.source_cn: 如果能用上魔法，我们能创造出超越一切的神器，能复兴早已...

say:46:1410341025:0.text: Are you out of your mind?! For this impossible dream, you'll drag the whole village down with you!
say:46:1410341025:0.source_cn: 你疯了吗？！为了这份不切实际的幻想，你会把整个村子都搭进去！

say:49:1410341026:0.text: When faced with the pinnacle of craftsmanship... family, friends, country... <shk>None of it matters!</shk>
say:49:1410341026:0.source_cn: 在至高的技艺面前……亲人，朋友，国家……<shk>全都...

say:52:1410341027:0.text: Stop chasing your delusions! Helthor cannot be resurrected!
say:52:1410341027:0.source_cn: 别再做你那美梦了！我根本不相信赫托能被复活！

say:55:1410341028:0.text: Without magic, we're just ordinary tinkers! Doomed to mediocrity! Don't you want to bring back the glory of the past?!
say:55:1410341028:0.source_cn: 无法使用魔法的我们，终究只是平凡庸俗的创造者！你不想恢...

say:58:1410341029:0.text: I do... but not through these methods!
say:58:1410341029:0.source_cn: 我想……但我不认同你的做法！我有自己的打算！

say:61:1410341030:0.text: Then there's nothing more to say. The future of the dwarves is coming, and you... you'll be cast into the slag!

choice:40:0:1.source_cn: 所以你杀了那些调查员？

choice:37:0:1.source_cn: 所以你们矮人并不是真的谋逆？
